title: 第二十二章 帮忙第二十三章 测试
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
“阿峰，要不...跟我哥说说？”
陈星想起从小到大，自己跟哥哥虽然时常争吵。
但每每遇到什么问题，对方总能解决。
听着陈星的劝告。
李峰低头沉默，最终缓缓点头，选择将事情告知陈洛。
“嫖娼啊...”
虽说早早就知道事情原委，更想好了要怎么做。
但陈洛还是装出一副，尴尬又有些吃惊的模样。
“没事的，洛哥。”
“其实不是什么大事，就是说出去有些丢人而已。”
李峰挤出笑容。
今天的这顿晚饭，是他自上初中以来吃过的，最开心的一顿。
陈星愿意在生日时，带他回家里吃饭。
李峰心里其实十分感激，只是碍于青少年莫名的自尊心，实在难以说出什么真情实感的话来。
因此，
对于陈星的哥哥，他自觉得没什么隐瞒的必要。
叮咚——
三人对话间，电梯抵达一层。
“没事，我帮你问问看。”
陈洛走在前头，带着二人前往小区门口。

“陈星，叫个车去治安局。”
“好。”
得到肯定的答复后。
陈洛便掏出手机，翻开通讯录。
先前的小偷事件中，他与治安官马队交换了联系方式。
那位持有【都市兵王】模板的矮胖男人曾说过，如果陈洛遇到什么事，大可以找他帮忙。
虽然是客气话。
但陈洛在从小与人交际的过程中，早早便领悟到一个道理。
想和一个没有太大利益牵扯的人拉近关系。
最好的办法，不是示好，不是帮助。
而是找件不大不小的事情，请求对方帮忙。
根据他的观察。
在面对一个自己曾经帮助过的对象时，大部分人的心理，都会出现不同程度的放松。
“喂，小陈？”
电话那头，传来治安官马队浑厚的声音。
“马队，是这样的...”
陈洛简单向对方阐述事情经过。
听完后，电话另一头传来马队沉吟的声音。
“嫖娼吗...”
“我先帮你打电话问问情况，一会回你电话。”

“好，谢谢马队。”
挂断电话。
content_en:
"A Feng, why don't you... talk to my brother?"
Chen Xing recalled that since he was a child, he and his brother had often quarreled.
But every time we encounter any problem, the other party can always solve it.
Listen to Chen Xing's advice.
Li Feng lowered his head in silence, and finally nodded slowly, choosing to inform Chen Luo of the matter.
"Whoring..."
Although I knew the whole story early on, I even thought about what to do.
But Chen Luo still pretended to be embarrassed and a little surprised.
"It's okay, Brother Luo."
"Actually, it's not a big deal, it's just a little embarrassing to say it out."
Li Feng forced a smile.
Today's dinner was the happiest meal he had had since entering junior high school.
Chen Xing is willing to take him home for dinner on his birthday.
Li Feng was actually very grateful in his heart, but due to the inexplicable self-esteem of teenagers, it was really difficult to say anything sincere.
Therefore,
Regarding Chen Xing's brother, he felt that there was no need to hide anything.
Ding dong——
While the three of them were talking, the elevator reached the first floor.
"It's okay, let me ask for you."
Chen Luo walked in front and led the two of them to the gate of the community.
"Chen Xing, call a car and go to the Public Security Bureau."
"Okay."
After getting a positive answer.
Chen Luo took out his mobile phone and opened his address book.
He had exchanged contact information with the Sheriff's Horse Team during the previous thief incident.
The short, fat man holding the template of "Urban Soldier King" once said that if Chen Luo encounters anything, you can ask him for help.
Although they are kind words.
But in the process of interacting with people since childhood, Chen Luo realized a truth early on.
I want to get closer to someone who I don't have much interest in.
The best way is not to show kindness or help.
Instead, find something not too big or too small and ask the other person for help.
According to his observation.
Most people will relax to varying degrees when facing someone they have helped.
"Hello, Xiao Chen?"
On the other end of the phone, the rich voice of the Sheriff's cavalry came.
"The cavalry team is like this..."
Chen Luo briefly explained what happened to the other party.
After listening, the pensive voice of the horse team came from the other end of the phone.
"Whoring?"
"I'll call you first to ask about the situation, and I'll call you back later."
"Okay, thank you, horse team."
Hang up.
